title: Vector Clock Drift
tagline: Compare causality tracking strategies under increasing message load and skew.

curves.label: Scalar Timestamp
curves.code: t=0; for(msg=0; msg<n; msg++){ t=Math.max(t+1, recvTime[msg]); }
curves.name: Scalar Timestamp

curves.label: Vector Clock (Full)
curves.code:
V=new Array(p).fill(0); for(m=0;m<n;m++){ i=sender[m]; V[i]++; // merge O(p)
for(j=0;j<p;j++) V[j]=Math.max(V[j], recvV[m][j]); }
curves.name: Vector Clock (Full)

curves.label: Sparse Vector Clock
curves.code:
S=new Map(); for(m=0;m<n;m++){ i=sender[m]; S.set(i,(S.get(i)||0)+1); // merge only present entries
for([k,v] of recvSparseV[m]) S.set(k,Math.max(S.get(k)||0,v)); }
curves.name: Sparse Vector Clock

curves.label: Interval/Causality Compression
curves.code:
I=new Map(); for(m=0;m<n;m++){ i=sender[m]; // merge contiguous intervals
advanceInterval(I,i,recvInterval[m]); }
curves.name: Interval/Causality Compression
